hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */lua/plugins/theme.lua) echo 'theme.lua is a symlink into ~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/ - edit the omarchy theme source instead; changes here are clobbered on theme switch' >&2; exit 2 ;; */lazy-lock.json) echo 'lazy-lock.json is owned by :Lazy update/restore - do not hand-edit' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.lua) luajit -b "$f" /dev/null || exit 2; sty=$(command -v stylua || echo ~/.local/share/nvim/mason/bin/stylua); [ -x "$sty" ] && "$sty" "$f" ;; esac; case "$f" in */lua/config/keymaps.lua) cd ~/.config/nvim && nvim --headless "+luafile scripts/dump-keymaps.lua" +qa ;; esac; exit 0
